scope: MPFR linear kernel validation on frozen recorded binary64 systems
interpretation: Both recorded systems agree with independent Decimal160 solutions within binary64 rounding scale. MPFR256 and MPFR512 return identical binary64 coordinates. Pivot, singular-system and nonfinite-input controls pass. Residuals are evaluated after binary64 output rounding; they are not MPFR internal residuals. Existing extreme solved states and earlier integration history are not repaired by this frozen-system check.
nextAction: Integrate the verified kernel into an isolated experimental ngspice runtime. Require a disabled control to reproduce baseline waveform bytes and failure, then test higher-precision transient evolution without changing physical equations or convergence criteria.
